bio: Housed within the stylish Rosselli Hotel, on one of Valletta’s most elegant streets, Under Grain welcomes guests into a setting that is as sophisticated as its cuisine. The restaurant occupies the building’s historic lower level, where guests pass by the kitchen before entering a dining room with a vaulted stone ceiling and dark, atmospheric decor. Inspired by the tailor shops that once lined Merchant Street, the restaurant weaves this theme throughout, from the sewing-pattern menus to displays of garments, and even the pincushion used to present the bill. The score is depicted by a concise à la carte lineup and a tasting menu, both of which reveal the chef’s distinctly creative bent.
